scenario: LGRA.8.1 `binding?` on the LGRA.8.5 follower. Pin: `A a` then `B within 30_s` compiles when the FOLLOWER is unbound. PATH PINNED: `dsc.parse`'s `lgra_8_5_2_parse_then_line`, where the keyword `within` comes straight after the type. The written `a` is referenced in the action because [LGRA.8.6] makes a written binding no one references an error.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

schema B scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

rule r:
    A a
    then B within 30_s
->
    log info "{a.id}"
